name: Dictation
summary: Offline voice dictation into text fields
description: On-device English voice dictation with live streaming and automatic punctuation, integrated with Keyboard Improved. Runs completely offline using bundled Asr4All speech weights.
author: thooton

changes.text: Keep streaming model feedback caches in the native runtime.
Verify VFPv4/FMA on compiled object file since LLD inherits crtbegin ARM attributes.
Force neon-vfpv4 compile flags on armeabi-v7a and parse llvm-readelf ARM attributes.
Add ExecuTorch v1.6.0 native runtime, benchmark CLI, JNI library, and CI build workflow.
Fetch libasr4all.so from the immutable dictation-runtime-0239ff6 release.
Plain blue microphone badge beside the dictation caret.
Pin armeabi-v7a libasr4all.so SHA-256, drop per-step stream cache copy, guard debug WAV background start.
Add offline on-device dictation core and app.
